authority.allowed_compute: local CPU and already-persisted artifacts only
authority.user_authorized_inputs: Task time and other algorithm-visible Task attributes may be supplied by a user or adapter and must affect replay after being frozen with explicit provenance.

correction.finding: The v1 SWE-bench static adapter assigns source observed_at to every Check, while the Records contract says certification time is not historical material availability and counterfactual replay reconstructs historical availability.
correction.effect_on_previous_terminal_state: The zero-mature-Origin result establishes an adapter/input-semantics limitation, not that the paid outcomes are intrinsically unusable for counterfactual replay.
correction.preserved_boundary: No projected scenario is strict-prospective evidence, and no source-attested historical Check time is claimed without a source binding.

observed_at_floor.role: negative control that must remain fully censored at historical Origins

label_at_task_arrival.check_material_available_at: set each Check availability equal to its bound Task task_material_available_at in a new immutable scenario view
label_at_task_arrival.role: user-configured counterfactual scenario and primary public-pipeline replay

counterfactual_result_visibility.rule: For counterfactual replay, a persisted Result may enter a Selector input when its exact Task/Check ref is in the Origin's mature history and its Agent and cache identity match, irrespective of the physical 2026 Result observation time.
counterfactual_result_visibility.future_leakage_guard: Future Task/Check refs remain outside the Origin history; every Selection is frozen before its future outcome matrix is opened.
counterfactual_result_visibility.strict_prospective_rule: Strict prospective inputs continue to reject Results observed after the Origin cutoff.
counterfactual_result_visibility.identity_rule: The exact Result IDs and digests in each visible view remain frozen in SelectorInput and FeatureSnapshot provenance.

implementation_contract.task_candidate_import: Canonical user imports retain explicit task_material_available_at, check_material_available_at, dependency_cluster_id, and sampling_stratum without platform replacement.
implementation_contract.static_adapter: The SWE-bench static adapter accepts an explicit Check-availability basis and binds it into Generator behavior identity; its historical observed_at behavior remains an explicit option.
implementation_contract.selection: Counterfactual Result visibility is distinguished by existing eligibility_mode; no new workflow engine, plugin registry, Feature Store, or mutable Result is introduced.
implementation_contract.records: Published source Task Pools and managed Results remain byte-identical; experiments create new scenario evidence rather than editing them.

required_evidence: A public regression test proves strict prospective rejects a post-cutoff Result while counterfactual replay accepts the same exact history-bound Result.
A public adapter test proves the configured Check-availability basis changes candidate Check time and Generator behavior identity while retaining observation provenance.
The observed-at negative control remains censored.
The label-at-task-arrival scenario produces twelve nonempty public RollingOrigins and public deterministic Selections.
Public Selection membership and future_pass_rate_mae are compared against the frozen transparent diagnostic for every primary Selector and Origin.
Any disagreement is retained and diagnosed rather than tuned away.
insufficient_outcomes: Changing only the experiment-local diagnostic without exercising public Selection APIs.
Overwriting the published Task Pool, Check records, Results, or prior study artifacts.
Treating user-configured or synthetic time as source-attested history.
Using post-origin Task refs or future outcomes during Selection.
Adding generic extension machinery without a concrete exercised contract.

approach_registry.thesis: Counterfactual replay should gate persisted outcomes by mature history membership, while strict prospective continues to gate by physical Result time.
approach_registry.decisive_test: One exact Result after the cutoff is accepted only in counterfactual mode and remains provenance-bound.

approach_registry.thesis: Alternative Result evidence records could carry projected effective times without changing execution identity.
approach_registry.decisive_test: Adopt only if eligibility_mode cannot preserve replay, provenance, and leakage constraints directly.

approach_registry.thesis: A new immutable Task Pool scenario can vary algorithm-visible metadata while preserving execution identity and source lineage.
approach_registry.decisive_test: The public replay validates the scenario bundle and reuses exact existing Result cache identities without Agent calls.

approach_registry.thesis: Rebuild and recertify the 75 Tasks under new metadata.
approach_registry.decisive_test: Use only if execution-relevant identity changes or scenario lineage cannot be validated without rerunning Checks.
